Type: deco
Name: Amazon Brand – Stone & Beam Wall Decor Mirror, 30" x 40", Champagne Gold
Colors: Gold
Materials: Glass, polyurethane
This mirror is an eye-catching and functional piece of art that hangs vertically or horizontally to accent entryways and transitional areas. The intersecting designs create a frame to add a subtle design statement. 30" x 40"; hangs vertically (40"H) or horizontally (30"H) Modern design with touch of metallic glam Mirrored glass with pale gold framing design Avoid moisture. Wipes clean with soft, dry cloth. Hanging hardware not included.
